page.overview:
What is Bestoon Legacy?

The Bestoon Legacy was a modified WTK-85A interstellar transport and the personal starship of the assassin Ochi of Bestoon.

Ochi used the Bestoon Legacy throughout his assassin career, including during the quest to find the child Rey, granddaughter of the resurrected Sith Lord Darth Sidious. During the quest, Ochi allied with the Corporate Sector Authority and their liaison Enric Pryde, a former Imperial officer. The craft was briefly stolen by Rey's parents, Miramir and Dathan, to return Rey to the planet Jakku, only for a drunken Ochi to kill them and reclaim his ship. Traveling to the planet Pasaana on a false lead on Rey's location, Ochi died after sinking in the Shifting Mires, leaving his ship behind. For years the ship the intakes and thrusters began to fill with sand-clogs and nomadic solif-spiders left tons of silk strands.

During the First Order-Resistance War, the ship was used by Poe Dameron, Finn, Rey, C-3PO, and BB-8 after the First Order captured the Millennium Falcon. After Rey apparently killed Chewbacca by accident, the group escaped Pasaana in the ship, with Poe hiding the ship in an asteroid belt. Though they lost the dagger, its inscription was in C-3PO's memory. So, the group decided to head to Kijimi so that Babu Frik can perform a memory bypass, unaware that the Night Buzzard, the Knights of Ren's ship, was following them. The ship made planetfall and landed in Kijimi City, which was cracking down under the First Order's occupation.

After Babu Frik successfully retrieved the translation at the cost of C-3PO's memories, the group returned to the Bestoon Legacy and flew to the Steadfast hovering above the city to rescue Chewbacca. Poe used Zorii Bliss' First Order Captain's Medallion to get clearance to land aboard one of the ship's hangars, Hangar 12. Allegiant General Pryde, the very same former Imperial whom had met Ochi and seen his ship up close, and a detachment of stormtroopers went into the hangar, where Pryde was surprised to see the vessel and asked one of his subordinates who the ship belonged to. Poe Dameron's group later recovered the Falcon and rescued Chewbacca, and the First Order met its demise soon after.
